title: Cosmic Frog in Purple Bowl
description: A surreal scene features a giant cracked purple bowl resting on the Colosseum. Inside the bowl, a large green frog sits on a swirling blue snake while a bearded man in blue robes reaches up from the rim offering a red apple. A winged woman with green leafy hair and starry robes gestures from the center, surrounded by floating coins, flowers, and smaller figures emerging from the cosmic swirl above.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a massive cracked purple and gold bowl balanced atop the Roman Colosseum overlooking a coastal city. Inside the bowl a large green frog sits atop a thick blue snake that spirals upward. A bearded man in flowing blue robes reaches from the bowl's rim offering a red apple. A central female figure with green leafy hair, angel wings, and a starry robe gestures dramatically. Cosmic swirling galaxy of pink, purple and blue with floating coins, flowers and faces in the sky, highly detailed, vibrant colors.
